name: mainline_propagation_attribution_v1
analysis_type: Retrospective frozen-model saved-score attribution of all12 Stage41 tasks; no fresh experiment.
query_scope: All36 paired paid10/11/12 states. Verify saved constrained-TS scores; align physical policies. Attribute first divergences only under identical paid history and ordered pools. Later histories and altered pools are descriptive.
decomposition: Sampled risk margin = riskmean + z_alpha*sqrt(episodevariance) + realized constraint TS innovation (tau=0). Compare selected pair gap and bidirectional saved-component swaps; full8 riskcomponent subsets and objective mean/draw/all plus all components. Objective and risk reconstruction must reproduce original choices. No resampling.
terminal_scope: Derive full-only improving queried policies from all12 cachedtruth/histories; follow discovery, ordered shortlist, safety attempt, objectiveguard and deployment for both histories and terminals. Use all-observed native terminal components and available role shortlist metadata.
limits: Component substitutions are one-step saved-score sensitivity, not posterior ablations or alternate adaptive trajectories. TS innovation includes covariance/factorization/random-draw effects; off-diagonal covariance is not identified by marginal snapshots. Uncached truth stays unknown. Role omitted-candidate final numeric posterior is unavailable unless saved, never replaced with paid12 as paid13.
next_step_gate: No model change in this stage. A later single correction requires a shared mechanism across tasks and source-data support; otherwise retain initialization propagation plus point-only update as working baseline.
